name: dclm-current-code-public-resource-reference-v1

runtime_environment.note: The split training/data and evaluation images are an infrastructure adaptation: llm-foundry 0.9.0 requires a newer Torch/SentencePiece dependency set than the pinned OpenLM training stack. Both immutable SIF hashes are part of the run identity.

pipeline.note: Worker count and 128-way LSF file partitioning are hardware orchestration; document transforms are the pinned upstream functions.

Ten shards and min-ngram 20 are identified by the repository's recorded 400M baseline dataset. The repository does not publish the historical expected-ngram-count; 20B is a frozen conservative current-run value. Annotate is false so the BFF implementation applies removals to text instead of only adding unused span metadata. Upstream BFF randomizes file order and Bloom hash seeds without a seed CLI; the produced stage is therefore frozen and hashed as the matched baseline/candidate input, but is not claimed to be byte-identical across independent rebuilds.

training.hardware_mapping: 2 nodes x 8 H100; 16 ranks. Scientific global batch and accumulation are unchanged.

execution_gate.policy: Submit the full 8.232B-token run only after the same 411m_1x configuration completes qualification without a fatal error and passes all recorded topology, batch, memory, and conservative throughput checks.

repository_historical_record.purpose: sanity comparison only, not the current reference result
repository_historical_record.limitation: Its dataset and checkpoint URLs are redacted private S3 locations and its data commit predates the pinned current checkout.

fidelity_statement: This run reproduces the pinned repository's publicly executable current baseline and freezes every locally necessary choice. It does not claim byte-identical reconstruction of the repository's inaccessible 2024 private S3 dataset/checkpoint. The separately downloaded 96-parquet released-DCLM smoke slice is excluded from this reference.
